mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals imminent monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution shows negative median returns in all periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates a restrictive monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP and housing starts signals robust consumer demand, increasing corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances over a 5-year window, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with UNRATE > 6.5%, or the Rank IC for the signal is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO trend fails to correlate with positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index rises above 235.0 in monthly terms, it indicates accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real sales and employment signals strong consumer and business spending, increasing equity valuation multiples and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and PAYEMS fails to produce positive returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% q/q), robust economic growth fuels corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with GDPC1 growth > 2.5% q/q, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
